PreschoolKindergarten–Grade 8Life at Trinity

Ages 3 & 4

A joyful start
to learning.

Preschool combines early academics with the social skills children develop as they learn, create, and make friends in a Christian setting.

  • Age-appropriate introductions to reading and math
  • Bible, technology, music, and library skills
  • Art and Body Rhythmics
  • After-school care until 5:30 p.m.

Questions about preschool? Contact the school and ask for Preschool Director Eloise Lambright.

Ask about preschool

Kindergarten – Grade 8

Challenge, confidence,
and character.

Trinity’s K–8 program combines a rigorous curriculum with support from caring teachers and staff. Students build knowledge while learning to contribute to their school community.

  • Academics that extend beyond state standards
  • Art, music, physical education, and Bible
  • Classroom technology and iPads in the upper grades
  • Theater and competitive athletics
  • After-school care until 5:30 p.m.
Explore K–8 admissions

Beyond the classroom

Life at Trinity

01

Fine arts & athletics

Students can explore art, music, and theater, with sports opportunities including volleyball, basketball, golf, and cross country.

02

Shared traditions

World Bazaar, Chapel Buddies, Famous Persons, Pop’s Night Out, and Grandparent’s Day connect learning with the wider school family.

03

Learning beyond school

Educational field trips give students opportunities to connect classroom learning with places, people, and experiences.
